nodes.name: AssetAssignmentRepository.java
nodes.summary: AssetAssignment repository: JPA repository with findByAssetId, findByUserIdAndStatus, findOverdueAssignments, findByDateRange. Used for assignment tracking and overdue alerts.

nodes.name: AssetCategoryRepository.java
nodes.summary: AssetCategory repository: JPA repository with findByCode, findByParentCategoryId, findActiveCategories, findTree. Supports category hierarchy traversal.

nodes.name: AssetImageRepository.java
nodes.summary: AssetImage repository: JPA repository with findByAssetId, findPrimaryByAssetId. Image management per asset.

nodes.name: AssetInventoryLogRepository.java
nodes.summary: AssetInventoryLog repository: JPA repository with findByAssetIdOrderByPerformedAtDesc, findByAction, findByDateRange, findByPerformedBy. Audit trail queries.

nodes.name: AssetMaintenanceRepository.java
nodes.summary: AssetMaintenance repository: JPA repository with findByAssetId, findByStatus, findOverdueMaintenance, findByScheduledDateBetween, findByMaintenanceType. Maintenance scheduling and tracking.

nodes.name: AssetRepository.java
nodes.summary: Asset repository: JPA repository with findByCode, findByCategoryId, findByStatus, findByAssignedUserId, searchByNameOrCode, findAssetsNeedingMaintenance, findAssetsNearWarrantyExpiry. Core asset queries.

nodes.name: AssetRequestRepository.java
nodes.summary: AssetRequest repository: JPA repository with findByUserId, findByStatus, findByCategoryId, findPendingRequests, findByDateRange. Request tracking and approval workflow.

nodes.name: AssetCategorySeeder.java
nodes.summary: Asset category seeder: CommandLineRunner that populates default asset categories (Laptop, Monitor, Phone, Furniture, Vehicle, Software License, Peripheral) on application startup if empty.

nodes.name: AssetService.java
nodes.summary: Asset service: core business logic for asset lifecycle (create, update, delete, assign, return, maintenance, depreciation calculation, inventory logging). Integrates with FileStorageService for images, AssetRepository, AssetAssignmentRepository, AssetCategoryRepository, AssetImageRepository, AssetInventoryLogRepository, AssetMaintenanceRepository, AssetRequestRepository.

nodes.name: DashboardController.java
nodes.summary: Dashboard REST controller: endpoints for getSummary (role-based: admin/hr sees company stats, manager sees team stats, staff sees personal stats), getAttendanceTrends, getLeaveBalance, getUpcomingEvents, getNotifications. Aggregates data from multiple services.

nodes.name: DashboardSummaryResponse.java
nodes.summary: Dashboard summary response DTO: role-specific fields. Admin/HR: totalEmployees, pendingLeaves, pendingOvertime, pendingAssets, activeTickets, payrollStatus. Manager: teamSize, teamPendingLeaves, teamPendingOvertime, teamAttendanceRate. Staff: myAttendanceStatus, myLeaveBalance, myPendingRequests, myUpcomingShifts.

nodes.name: DashboardService.java
nodes.summary: Dashboard service: aggregates data from UserProfileRepository, AttendanceRepository, LeaveRequestRepository, OvertimeRecordRepository, AssetRequestRepository, ItTicketRepository, PayrollRepository. Builds role-specific summary. Uses SpecificationScopes for dynamic filtering.

nodes.name: DocumentController.java
nodes.summary: Document REST controller: endpoints for uploadDocument, getDocuments (paginated, filtered), getDocumentDetail, downloadDocument, deleteDocument, updateDocumentMetadata, getDocumentCategories. Integrates with ai-service for indexing via DocumentService.

nodes.name: UpsertDocumentRequest.java
nodes.summary: Upsert document request DTO: documentId (optional for update), title, category, tags, description, file (MultipartFile). Validation for file type/size and required fields.

nodes.name: DocumentResponse.java
nodes.summary: Document response DTO: documentId, title, category, tags, description, fileUrl, fileType, fileSize, uploadedBy, uploadedAt, indexedAt, indexStatus. Metadata for document listing and detail.

nodes.name: Document.java
nodes.summary: Document JPA entity: id, title, category, tags (JSON array), description, filePath, fileType, fileSize, minioBucket, minioObjectKey, uploadedBy, uploadedAt, indexedAt, indexStatus (PENDING, INDEXED, FAILED), indexError. Links to MinIO storage and ai-service indexing.

nodes.name: DocumentCategory.java
nodes.summary: DocumentCategory enum: POLICY, CONTRACT, HANDBOOK, FORM, REPORT, TEMPLATE, LEGAL, TRAINING, OTHER. Classification for document organization and retrieval filtering.

nodes.name: DocumentErrorCode.java
nodes.summary: DocumentErrorCode enum: DOCUMENT_NOT_FOUND, INVALID_FILE_TYPE, FILE_TOO_LARGE, UPLOAD_FAILED, DELETE_FAILED, INDEXING_FAILED, CATEGORY_NOT_FOUND, PERMISSION_DENIED. Used by DocumentException.

nodes.name: DocumentFileType.java
nodes.summary: DocumentFileType enum: PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, TXT, PNG, JPG, JPEG. Allowed file types for upload validation.

nodes.name: DocumentException.java
nodes.summary: Document exception: extends RuntimeException with DocumentErrorCode. Caught by GlobalExceptionHandler.

nodes.name: DocumentRepository.java
nodes.summary: Document repository: JPA repository with findByCategory, findByUploadedBy, findByIndexStatus, searchByTitleOrTags, findByDateRange, findPendingIndexing. Supports pagination and sorting.

nodes.name: DocumentService.java
nodes.summary: Document service: handles upload (MinIO via FileStorageService), metadata management, deletion, and triggers ai-service indexing via async call. Manages index status lifecycle (PENDING -> INDEXED/FAILED).
